items.name: Premium Navy Blue Cotton Shirt
items.shortDescription: A versatile navy blue shirt with a classic collar, chest pocket and clean finish. Easy to pair with jeans or trousers for casual days and office wear.
items.description: Keep your everyday style simple and confident with the SHADOW SHOP Premium Navy Blue Shirt. Its solid colour, button front and classic collar make it suitable for both relaxed and smart casual outfits. The shirt features a chest pocket, full sleeves and a neat finish. Pair it with light trousers for a sharp contrast or wear it with denim for an easy daily look.
